about:
# Docked Damage Meter

World of Warcraft addon that places your damage meter in a chat tab, replacing the combat log.

- Project on Curse: https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/docked-damage-meter
- Project on Wago: https://addons.wago.io/addons/dockeddamagemeter
- Project on GitHub: https://github.com/z0fa/DockedDamageMeter
- Donate: https://paypal.me/z0fa
